name: kn-special-regimes
description: Saint Kitts and Nevis special regimes in 2026: virtual asset businesses (Virtual Asset Act 2020 as amended; EC$54,000 application and EC$135,000 registration fees, renewal by 31 January with a EC$100 a day late fee, 15% escrow of client funds, audited statements within four months, the 2026 regulations SRO 13 of 2026), fiscal incentives for approved manufacturing, small business and hotel concessions, Special Sustainability Zones (Act 21 of 2025), the end of the Nevis IBC and LLC offshore tax exemptions (entities formed by 31 December 2018, ended by 30 June 2021) and their record rules, and gaming licences (21-day change notices, Nevis online gaming). Trigger phrases include St Kitts virtual asset registration, Nevis crypto licence, St Kitts fiscal incentives, Nevis IBC tax exemption, Special Sustainability Zone, Nevis online gaming licence.
